statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by 25 basis points at its scheduled 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-16 meeting, lifting the range to 3.75-4.00 percent.
resolution: The FOMC policy statement dated 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov sets the federal funds target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent. A hold, a cut, or any other size of move resolves false.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 statement leaves the range at 3.50 to 3.75 percent, or sets any range other than 3.75 to 4.00 percent.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude posts an official settlement at or above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: ICE Futures Europe published settlement data for the Brent front-month contract shows at least one daily settlement at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel dated between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Every Brent front-month settlement dated inside the window prints below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-81578 or CVE-2026-82078, the actively exploited PaperCut NG and MF flaws, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry for CVE-2026-81578 or CVE-2026-82078 whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither CVE carries a KEV dateAdded value inside that range at the deadline.

statement: CISA adds at least one ServiceNow vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry whose vendorProject field is ServiceNow and whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject ServiceNow carries a dateAdded inside that range.

statement: Ukrainian authorities report Russian drone or missile impacts inside Kyiv city on at least six separate calendar days between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Kyiv City Military Administration or Ukrainian Air Force statements, each carried by Reuters, AFP, or AP, place drone or missile impacts inside Kyiv city on six or more distinct days in the window.
failure_condition: Five or fewer distinct calendar days inside the window carry a corroborated impact report for Kyiv city.

statement: Iran halts commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz for at least 72 consecutive hours at some point between 2026-09-01 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: Two of Reuters, Lloyds List, and AP report that commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz was suspended by Iranian action for 72 or more consecutive hours inside the window.
failure_condition: No Iranian-imposed suspension of Hormuz commercial transit reaches 72 consecutive hours inside the window.

statement: The United States and Iran hold direct, publicly acknowledged government-to-government talks between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Officials of both governments publicly confirm a direct meeting between US and Iranian representatives held inside the window, reported by two of Reuters, AP, and AFP. Indirect mediation only resolves false.
failure_condition: No meeting inside the window is acknowledged by both governments as direct US-Iran contact.

statement: The USGS Geographic Names Information System records Lake America as the official feature name for the waterbody currently named Lake Ontario, entered between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: A GNIS query for the Lake Ontario feature returns an official name of Lake America when checked on 2026-12-15. Any other official name, including Lake Ontario, resolves false.
failure_condition: GNIS still returns Lake Ontario as the official feature name on 2026-12-15.

statement: Combined confirmed deaths from the Nepal-Tibet glacial outburst flood reach 1,000 or more at some point between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: Nepal Police and Chinese authority tolls, as reported by two of Reuters, AP, and AFP, sum to 1,000 or more confirmed dead on any date inside the window.
failure_condition: The highest combined confirmed toll reported inside the window remains below 1,000.

statement: Austrian authorities announce at least one arrest in the Vienna museum theft of the 673-diamond necklace between 2026-08-29 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Vienna police or the Austrian public prosecutor announce an arrest or detention connected to the necklace theft, reported by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, and DPA, inside the window.
failure_condition: No arrest or detention connected to the theft is announced by Austrian authorities inside the window.
